unmet_need.name: Unmet-need / complaint mining
unmet_need.evidence_pattern: people in a specific role or business describing a recurring problem, workaround or wish in forums, communities and reviews
queries: $subject "is there a tool" OR "wish there was" reddit
$subject "how do you handle" small business owners

incumbent_weakness.name: Incumbent-weakness mining
incumbent_weakness.evidence_pattern: users of an existing product complaining about price, missing features, complexity or poor fit for their segment
queries: $subject software too expensive for small teams reviews

regulatory_tech_change.name: Regulatory / technology-change mining
regulatory_tech_change.evidence_pattern: a specific recent regulation, rule, deadline, standard or technology change that creates a new obligation or makes a new solution possible for a specific group
queries: $subject API or platform change impact businesses
$subject law change what businesses need to do

manual_process.name: Expensive-manual-process mining
manual_process.evidence_pattern: job posts, service offerings or workflow descriptions showing people paid to do repetitive manual work that software or a small service could take over
queries: $subject job posting data entry coordinator manual
$subject hours per week spent on paperwork

market_inefficiency.name: Market-inefficiency / arbitrage mining
market_inefficiency.evidence_pattern: a gap between supply and demand, an underserved distribution channel, or a large price difference for the same thing between markets or segments
queries: $subject buyers can't find sellers marketplace gap

community_obsession.name: Community-obsession mining
community_obsession.evidence_pattern: a subreddit, Discord server or fan community repeatedly asking for a feature, bot or companion app that doesn't exist yet
queries: $subject subreddit "someone should make" OR "why isn't there"
$subject fandom wiki missing tool community asks for

app_store_gap.name: App-store gap mining
app_store_gap.evidence_pattern: App Store or Play Store reviews of a popular app complaining about a missing feature, bad UX, or naming a specific alternative they wish existed
queries: $subject app reviews "wish it had" OR "missing feature"
$subject app store one star review feature request
$subject game "needs an update" players asking for
$subject app complaints too expensive in-app purchases
$subject app store reviews bug unfixed for years

llm_capability_unlock.name: LLM-capability-unlock mining
llm_capability_unlock.evidence_pattern: a recent model, API or AI feature release that makes a consumer product newly possible or dramatically cheaper to build, described in launch posts, changelogs or developer discussion
queries: $subject new AI model release changes what's possible
$subject AI feature launch hacker news discussion
$subject multimodal voice AI new app idea

creator_tooling_gap.name: Creator-tooling gap mining
creator_tooling_gap.evidence_pattern: streamers, YouTubers, indie game developers or other online creators describing a workflow pain, manual task or missing tool in their content pipeline
queries: $subject youtuber manually edits because no tool exists
$subject indie game dev marketing pain forum
$subject creator economy complaint no good tool

viral_mechanic_mining.name: Viral/growth-mechanic mining
viral_mechanic_mining.evidence_pattern: post-mortems, growth breakdowns or retrospectives explaining what made a social or gaming app spread quickly, in a niche that hasn't seen the same mechanic yet
queries: $subject app growth breakdown what made it viral
$subject social app growth hack case study
why did $subject app go viral analysis
$subject indie game marketing success story reddit
$subject app "grew to" users organic no niche equivalent
